schemaRelaxations.multipart_attachment_id: Discord multipart upload descriptors use zero-based numeric ids; the preview OpenAPI component incorrectly models every attachment id as a Snowflake string.

rationale.auth: Webhook execute operations authenticate with the webhook token embedded in the path, which the preview OpenAPI security declarations omit.
rationale.auditLogReason: Discord's endpoint documentation declares X-Audit-Log-Reason support, but the preview OpenAPI operation metadata does not.
rationale.gloss: The preview OpenAPI has no operation summaries and sparse descriptions, so maintained natural-language terms make common operations discoverable.

gloss.create_message: send post message to a Discord channel
gloss.list_guild_channels: list channels categories in a Discord server
gloss.create_guild_channel: create a channel or category in a Discord server
gloss.list_guild_roles: list roles and hierarchy in a Discord server
